For the 2015 freshmen cohort of the history degree programme at the University of Lagos, their classmate’s first-semester presentation was so captivating that they began calling him Toby Shang, after the 16th-century Chinese dynasty he had focused on.
His crowd engagement that day had been harnessed from his high school days as a ginger-man (energiser) in a three-man band and as a private tutor. By his final year at university, his viral catchphrases and infectious energy had resulted in a hit song, Shedibalabala. Today, he is one of the self-acclaimed “evangelists and pioneers” in the Afrobeats sub-genre some are now calling Afrohype or lamba.

articles.title: Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods
articles.description:
Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece
In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday.
Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico. By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted.

articles.title: ‘4,000 people minding our own business’: four decades on, Falklands again face a hostile Argentina
articles.description:
Facing a slump in the polls, Argentina’s president is making economic attacks on the islands’ oil industry, and suggesting its key fisheries industry could be next 
A dozen local people and a uniformed military police officer (“Do you mind if I sit in?”) took their seats at the back of the handsome wood-panelled courtroom that doubles as the Falkland Islands’ legislative assembly. Outside, it was a typically blowy early evening. It may nominally be spring in the south Atlantic, but Stanley harbour, with its dark grey water speckled with historical shipwrecks, was a cauldron of swells and churn.
Six of the assembly’s eight members – five men, one woman – waited patiently at a row of desks and microphones. The heating had been turned up to just short of uncomfortable. Behind them, a portrait of King Charles. From the other walls, dusty photographs of governors peered down on the scene.

articles.title: Trump’s ‘Agreements on Reciprocal Trade’ (ARTs) threaten equitable access to the internet in Global South
articles.description: The controversial reciprocal trade agreements (ARTs) gives the U.S. a great deal of power, which could adversely affect digital connectivity, increase digital divides, and reduce economic growth in signatory countries.

articles.summary: フィリピンでタマネギ価格を不当に吊り上げた「タマネギカルテル」に対し、2800万ドルの罰金が科せられた。2022年にはタマネギ価格が日給を上回る事態に。

articles.description: Children were buried under the debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police say.

articles.summary: パキスタンで学校の屋根が3つの教室を貫通して崩落し、警察によると生徒33人と教師1人が死亡した。子どもたちが瓦礫の下敷きとなった。

articles.title: Actor Imran Khan ordered to leave India after participating in protest

articles.summary: ボリウッド俳優のイムラン・カーンが、10月10日にムンバイのデモに参加した後に拘束され、釈放されたが、インドからの退去を命じられた。

articles.summary: デリーの象徴的な抗議現場である18世紀のジャンタル・マンタルが、デモサイトとしての指定を取り消された。これはデリーにおける抗議活動の歴史にとって重要な転換点となる可能性がある。

articles.title: WTO and multilateral partners review progress on supply chain finance initiative
articles.description: Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala joined leaders of multilateral development banks and other international organizations at a high-level roundtable held on the sidelines of the 2026 World Bank – International Monetary Fund (IMF) Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Thailand, on 16 October to review progress in expanding supply chain finance in developing economies and to discuss priorities for the next phase of cooperation.
articles.titleJa: WTOと多国間パートナーがサプライチェーン金融イニシアチブの進捗をレビュー
articles.summary: WTO、世界銀行、IMFの年次総会において、多国間パートナーがサプライチェーン金融の拡大に向けた進捗を協議。特に開発途上国における金融支援の強化と今後の協力について議論された。

articles.title: Import Licensing Committee addresses notifications, trade concerns, transparency efforts
articles.description: At its 15 October meeting, the WTO Committee on Import Licensing examined challenges for WTO members in preparing notifications, including findings from a recent WTO workshop for government officials. It also reviewed the latest information on members' notification practices. In addition, the Committee considered a range of trade concerns and reflected on lessons from recent experience-sharing sessions aimed at strengthening communication, public-private engagement and access to information on import licensing procedures.
articles.titleJa: 輸入許可委員会が通知、貿易懸念、透明性向上への取り組みを議論
articles.summary: WTO輸入許可委員会が会議を開催。加盟国による通知作成の課題、貿易上の懸念、輸入許可手続きの透明性向上策について議論し、官民連携強化の重要性を確認した。

articles.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
articles.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
articles.titleJa: 東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉が開始
articles.summary: 政府調達委員会会議で、東ティモールの政府調達協定（GPA）への加盟交渉開始に向けた書類提出が歓迎された。委員会は規制動向もレビューし、民間部門との対話も実施した。

articles.title: Report underlines value of WTO committee in helping resolve market access trade concerns
articles.description: A first-ever report by the WTO Secretariat on the resolution of trade concerns related to market access highlights the effectiveness of the organization's committee work in helping members settle their differences without resorting to dispute settlement. The report was presented at a 12-13 October meeting of the WTO's Committee on Market Access (CMA). The committee also reviewed a record 36 trade concerns raised by members at its meeting, eight of which were raised for the first time.
articles.titleJa: 報告書が市場アクセス貿易懸念解決におけるWTO委員会の価値を強調
articles.summary: WTO事務局の報告書が、市場アクセスに関する貿易懸念解決における委員会の有効性を強調。委員会は36件の貿易懸念をレビューし、紛争解決に至らない形での問題解決に貢献している。

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
articles.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の菓子類に対しセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルは2026年10月9日、砂糖菓子およびチョコレート・ココア菓子の輸入に対しセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通知した。

articles.title: AI boom and trade resilience to Middle East crisis lift outlook, but gains to be uneven
articles.description: Global trade proved more resilient than expected in the first half of 2026 despite the disruption caused by the Middle East conflict, as supply chains adapted and strong investment in artificial intelligence provided a powerful boost to goods trade. However, the resilience was not uniform, with services trade and some regions more exposed to the effects of the conflict. WTO economists have therefore raised the forecast for merchandise trade growth in 2026 while lowering the outlook for services trade.
articles.titleJa: AIブームと中東危機への貿易回復力が展望を押し上げるも、恩恵は不均一
articles.summary: 2026年前半の国際貿易は、中東紛争にもかかわらずAI投資により予想以上に回復力を見せた。しかし、その恩恵はサービス貿易や一部地域で不均一であり、WTOは商品貿易予測を上方修正する一方、サービス貿易の展望を下方修正した。

articles.title: Services bodies spotlight Public Forum, remittance costs and development issues
articles.description: At meetings held from 7 to 9 October, the WTO Council for Trade in Services and the Committee on Trade in Financial Services commended the fruitful discussions on services trade at the 2026 Public Forum, continued discussions on transparency of measures regarding recognition of foreign service suppliers' qualifications, and exchanged views on how to reinvigorate the Council's work. Members also addressed how to facilitate digital payment systems and reduce the cost of remittances, help least-developed countries (LDCs) strengthen their participation in services trade, and various trade concerns.
articles.titleJa: サービス機関が公共フォーラム、送金コスト、開発問題に焦点
articles.summary: WTOサービス貿易理事会と金融サービス貿易委員会が会合を開催。サービス貿易に関する公共フォーラムの議論、外国サービス提供者の資格認定、デジタル決済、LDCのサービス貿易参加促進について議論された。

articles.title: Rules of Origin Committee reviews LDC preferences, shares best practices
articles.description: The WTO Committee on Rules of Origin (CRO) met on 7-8 October to review developments in preferential rules of origin for least-developed countries (LDCs), hear updates from preference-granting members, and exchange experiences on origin administration and trade facilitation. Members also examined notifications on non-preferential rules of origin, discussed digital tools that can improve transparency and compliance with origin requirements, and considered draft annual reports on the Committee's work.
articles.titleJa: 原産地規則委員会がLDC優遇措置をレビューし、ベストプラクティスを共有
articles.summary: WTO原産地規則委員会が会合を開催し、後発開発途上国（LDC）向け原産地規則の進展をレビュー。原産地管理のベストプラクティスを共有し、デジタルツールの活用や年次報告書案についても議論した。

articles.title: General Council addresses WTO reform, ministerial follow-ups, ongoing negotiations
articles.description: WTO members meeting at the General Council on 5-6 October addressed issues related to the ongoing discussions on WTO reform, follow-up to outcomes of past ministerial conferences, and the state of ongoing negotiations on various topics. Members also discussed issues related to the Agreement on Electronic Commerce, emerging agricultural trade issues, and optimizing the outcome of future ministerial conferences, among other issues.
articles.titleJa: 一般理事会がWTO改革、閣僚級会議のフォローアップ、進行中の交渉を議論
articles.summary: WTO一般理事会が会合を開き、WTO改革、過去の閣僚級会議の結果のフォローアップ、進行中の様々な交渉状況について議論。電子商取引協定や農業貿易問題なども検討された。

articles.title: Co-sponsors of sustainability initiative advance work plan towards MC15
articles.description: At a meeting on 2 October, co-sponsors of the Trade and Environmental Sustainability Structured Discussions (TESSD) discussed a work plan for 2026-27 in preparation for the 15th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC15). They identified priorities, working methods and potential deliverables for each work area, and expressed broad support for a transition towards more flexible and outcome-oriented work.
articles.titleJa: 持続可能性イニシアチブの共同提案者がMC15に向けた作業計画を推進
articles.summary: 貿易と環境持続可能性に関する構造化協議（TESSD）の共同提案者が会合を開き、第15回WTO閣僚会議（MC15）に向けた2026-27年の作業計画を議論した。
